name: Dalal Street Investments Limited
about: Dalal Street Investments Limited engages in the provision of advisory services, undertaking investment and trading activities. The company offers consulting services in the areas of strategy, capital needs, marketing, organization, operations, digital, analytics, corporate finance and mergers, various industrial acquisitions, and geographies. It is also involved in undertaking investment and trading activities. Dalal Street Investments Limited was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Mumbai, India.
